title: Admin toolbelt telemetry bridge for runbooks-as-tasks
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a lightweight telemetry bridge that connects the Admin Toolbelt (interactive admin utilities) to the runbooks-as-tasks runtime so every operator action executed from the toolbelt is captured as structured events. Goals: 1) surface per-step timing and token/cost estimates in Ops Console; 2) enable replayable dry-runs with idempotency markers for safe testing in the sandbox; 3) make telemetry minimal and privacy-respecting (no customer PII). This ticket scopes the bridge, the event schema, and a small shim library consumed by the toolbelt. Success metrics: consistent tracing for 90% of toolbelt actions, <5% CPU overhead on toolbelt host, and a telemetry pipeline transformation that adds token/cost attribution to existing dashboards.
